$comment: TaleX motion brand tokens. Single source for colors, type, easing, glow/blur and the pill badge. pipeline/build.mjs turns this into CSS custom properties (--tx-*) and window.__TALEX__.tokens for every scene.

format.why: Same 4:3 frame as the Higgsfield reference: more feed height on X than 16:9.

color_rules: Green #6FF000 is the main accent. On black it can be text (with bloom). On white it is ONLY a fill or accent (liquid, arrows, echo strokes, dots) and never thin text.
Violet #7B61FF is motion-only: speed streaks, echo outlines, RGB split, flashes. Never a resting color.
Background alternates pure black / pure white as punctuation between facts.
Text on white is black; text on black is white or bloom-green.

display.use: Headlines and all numbers. One heavy grotesk. Numbers ALWAYS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits never change width while counting.

caption.use: Bold caps captions under numbers and pills.

label.use: Pill label sitting on the top border (logo mark + name).

easing.$comment: GSAP ease strings. Use by name in scenes: T.ease.snap etc.

glow.$comment: Bloom = stacked text-shadows + a blurred duplicate layer. Values are for 1440x1080.

blur.$comment: Directional (horizontal) motion blur via SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 'X 0'. Only on beats that travel > 1 element-width per frame: whips, drags, slams.
blur.render_note: Render blur-heavy scenes with --workers 1 (multi-worker rendering can make animated blur flicker).

pill.$comment: Rounded-end badge. Label sits ON the top border (the border line is cut behind it). Caption in bold caps below.

echo.note: On entry 2-3 offset colored echo outlines trail the motion and collapse into one clean stroke.

glitch_reveal.$comment: Scrambled letter reveal ('Higgs i' -> 'Higgsfield'). Each letter resolves at a hashed time; before that it shows a hashed glyph or a gap.
